title: Chapter 228: Choosing A Battlefield
content:
Chapter 228: Choosing A Battlefield

Wang Shuo ordered the troops to rest on the spot, while he took Gong Zheng and others to survey the terrain and select the battlefield.

There was a hilly terrain nearby, but there was still a small alluvial plain on the edge of the river valley, which was suitable for cavalry charge.

The main force of Feima Village should be all cavalry, so it was very important to occupy a favorable high ground.

Soon, Wang Shuo found a gentle hill that was enough to overlook the entire alluvial plain.

Wang Shuo immediately brought all the infantry to the hill and stationed them.

The slope of the hill was 15 degrees and the length was about 2,000 meters, which was enough to slow down the charge of the opponent's cavalry.

At the same time, the catapult could also attack the plain, which was a very ideal strategic high ground.

Wang Shuo immediately created a large mud pit trap on one side of the hill as a barrier.

Prevent the horse bandits from attacking from this direction.

The crossbow battalion was arranged on this side, with archers in the middle and black mountain bandits and shield soldiers on the outermost layer.

It formed a solid defensive position.

After eating some dry food, the cavalry who were investigating also came back.

At the same time, they also captured several prisoners.

This made Wang Shuo very satisfied.

Through interrogation.

Wang Shuo learned that there are currently seven leaders in Feima Village, all of whom are military generals, with a level of about 40, and there are more than 800 horse bandits, each equipped with a warhorse.

Wang Shuo looked solemn.

The third leader he had killed before was only level 25. It seems that their levels have been improved a lot during this period.

At the same time, a trace of doubt arose in his heart.

Why didn't these horse bandits come to trouble him during this period? Don't they know that it was him who killed their third leader?

Wang Shuo couldn't figure it out.

In fact, after Good knew that Doliku was killed, he also thought about revenge, but with the improvement of intelligence, his feelings for these "brothers" were not so deep.

Moreover, during this period, he was busy improving his strength, and the looting was done by his subordinates.

He also understood that if there is no strength in this world, it will eventually be wiped out by the players.

Even this time, if it wasn't for the spies reporting that a large number of players were approaching Pegasus Village, he didn't want to pay attention.

Gude stopped practicing the "Spirit Snake Body Technique", frowned, looked a little impatient, and turned to the meeting room.

In the meeting room, several leaders were also present.

"Big Boss, there are a large number of players approaching our camp."

"These players are really full and have nothing better to do. They dare to offend me." Gude was very unhappy when he heard the report from his subordinates!

"Have you found out which force it is? How many people are coming?" Gude sat on the chair and wiped his beloved bow.

This bow is called the Sunset Bow, a strong bow of gold level. No one in Pegasus Village can pull this bow except Gude.

"The ones who are reporting back to the boss are soldiers from Wana Village, the same force that killed the third boss before."

"Great! I didn't go looking for trouble with him, but he came to me on his own initiative. He is simply looking for death."

Good stood up and ordered his men, "Gather, let's go to meet this Wana Village."

After gathering the troops, Good led more than 800 cavalrymen to the side of the alluvial plain, facing the hill where Wang Shuo's troops were located.

The cavalry of Feima Village are all light cavalry, mainly rangers and archers.

They are good at medium-range attacks, especially the 200 archers directly under Good, who are even more skilled in archery and horse riding, and can be called elite.

The two sides set up their formations and confronted each other.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel a little nervous. Looking at the formation, the other side didn't look like ordinary horse bandits at all, but rather a well-trained regular army.
